component.name: Apache Sentry
component.description: System for enforcing fine-grained role-based authorization to data and metadata stored on a Hadoop cluster. The referenced document is a wiki page listing vulnerabilities found in Apache Sentry (CVE-2018-8028 fixed in 2.0.1, CVE-2015-3254 fixed in 1.7.1, CVE-2016-0760 fixed in 1.7.0); it does not document a threat model, threats, or mitigations.

externalReferences.comment: Source security model document; this file is a structured translation of it. The page is a list of fixed CVEs only.
